items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Like when we were with Benny Goodman, joined the band.

ctx.x: Most guys were like that. I know my dearest friends like Buddy Laker and guys like that, we were together. But I would -- I can remember always (inaudible) I did because the inferiority was here and the inconvenience that that caused you. I didn't want anybody else to have to defend me. So I can understand your reverse prejudice.
Like when we were with Benny Goodman, joined the band. Well, I generally liked to room alone but we would get into a place like Ohio or someplace

and they wouldn't have any place for Cootie to stay. So I would check in in both our names and then Cootie would come in the room. And it broke my heart the first time he said, "You check in and I'll carry the bags in and act like I'm the band-boy." I said, "Bullshit. I'll check in and you walk in and I'll carry my own bags." That much I'll do.
